subject: Corner 7B: night activation, load-in windows & final signage specs
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Casey Liu <casey@sapphireevents.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Corner 7B — night activation & load-in constraints

Hi Casey / team —

Quick planning note for TechFront: we were assigned corner 7B in Hall C and want to run a short evening activation on the first night (demo + low-key happy hour, 6:00–9:00pm). A few questions before we finalize the signage/collateral orders:

- What are the official load-in / load-out windows for corner booths? Can we get an evening load-in slot on the show day (after 5pm) or is that restricted?
- Are there noise/decibel restrictions for after-hours activations? We expect amplified audio for the demo but will keep it low.
- Is a security escort or site supervisor required for setup after show hours? Any additional fees?
- Do you have the measured dimensions for corner 7B (particularly the finished carpeted edge to adjacent pillar)?

Attached: booth_floor_sketch_v1.pdf — current 20x20 mock with corner cap and demo riser.

If corner night activation is a no-go, we should pivot to an earlier demo window (4:30–5:30pm). Thoughts?

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: booth_floor_sketch_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Casey Liu <casey@sapphireevents.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Corner 7B — night activation & load-in constraints

Diego — thanks for the sketch and the heads-up. A few clarifications from venue ops: 

- Standard exhibitor load-in for Hall C is 0700–1700 on move-in day. After-hours load-in (after 1700) is allowed by exception only and requires a show ops escort; we can schedule a 1800–2000 slot but there is an after-hours labor fee ($95/hr for each crew member).
- After-hours activations are permitted until 2200 but amplified audio above 70dB is not allowed. Please submit a basic sound plan (max SPL, speaker placement).
- Rigging within corner cap areas needs prior approval from the venue; anything over 50 lbs requires a rigging plan and certified rigger.
- Corner 7B measured finished dimensions: 19.8ft x 19.6ft (carpet edge to pillar: 3.2ft). I attached the official floorplan for your reference.

Attachments: venue_floorplan_7B.pdf

If you want the after-hours slot, confirm by EOD Monday and we’ll request a security escort and the crew quote.

Best,
Casey Liu
Exhibit Operations Manager
Sapphire Events
[Attachment: venue_floorplan_7B.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Casey Liu <casey@sapphireevents.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Corner 7B — night activation & load-in constraints

Thanks Casey — the dimensions help. Diego / Lauren, quick marketing notes: 

- Signage: we planned a 10ft corner cap banner (double-sided). Need final clearance for cap rigging and exact hanging points. If rigging is blocked we’ll switch to two 8ft freestanding lightboxes. See signage_specs_3.pdf for dimensions and artwork tolerances.
- Demo stage: riser footprint 8ft x 6ft, with 2x floor boxes (power) and a single wired microphone. Can we get one 20A circuit?
- Catering: light finger food during the 6–9pm slot — venue flagged that a food permit and certificate of insurance may be required; Casey, can you confirm show policy?

If after-hours fees push costs too high, I support moving the activation earlier to 4:30–5:30 (more traffic, avoids extra crew).

Marissa Cole
Senior Events Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: signage_specs_3.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Casey Liu <casey@sapphireevents.com>, Rahul Kapoor <rahul@showops.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Corner 7B — night activation & load-in constraints

Great input — summary & proposed actions: 

1) We’ll request the 1800–2000 after-hours load-in slot with security escort (Casey: please submit crew request).
2) Marissa: we’ll provision audio limited to 70dB max; I’ll include speaker placement in the sound plan.
3) Lauren: please confirm ADA clearance needs; I want to avoid any aisle pinch points near the demo.
4) Rahul (ShowOps): please provide a preliminary quote for after-hours crew + one certified rigger + generator backup and confirm ability to hang the 10ft corner cap (if venue allows).

Drive folder with current assets and measurements: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_example_redwood_booth_plan — please add any updated CAD or vendor invoices there.

Action deadline: Friday 2026-11-19 so we can lock booth orders.

Thanks — Diego
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Rahul Kapoor <rahul@showops.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Casey Liu <casey@sapphireevents.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Corner 7B — night activation & load-in constraints (ShowOps quote)

Diego / Marissa / Lauren —

We can support the after-hours move-in and the corner cap rigging subject to venue approval. Preliminary estimate: 

- After-hours crew (2 techs) 1800–2000: $380 (2x $95/hr x 2 hours)
- Certified rigger (2 people, 3 hours) including hardware: $1,200
- Portable generator + fuel (standby for audio/lighting): $450
- Onsite supervisor and QA (evening) 1800–2200: $300

Subtotal: $2,330 (taxes & venue pass-throughs TBD). We’ll provide full insurance and Sak safety docs on request. Quote attached: quote_showops_7789.pdf.

We can also provision a single 20A floor box — confirm exact location on the final floorplan.

If you pivot to the earlier demo 16:30–17:30, the after-hours crew & generator line items can be removed and estimated cost drops to ~$600.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call to walk the quote — availability Wednesday morning PST.

Regards,
Rahul Kapoor
Operations Manager
ShowOps Productions
[Attachment: quote_showops_7789.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Casey Liu <casey@sapphireevents.com>, Rahul Kapoor <rahul@showops.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Corner 7B — night activation & load-in constraints

All — thanks for the fast turnaround. Final notes from Facilities & Compliance: 

- ADA: maintain a 36in clear aisle in front of the demo riser; move any freestanding collateral towers at least 24in from the carpet edge.
- Rigging: if the venue requires the certified rigger, use ShowOps quote and confirm that hardware meets the venue’s stamped certificates.
- Catering: Casey, please confirm whether the venue requires a certificate of insurance for the food vendor or if our exhibitor COI covers it.

Decision: we’ll proceed with the after-hours 1800–2000 move-in and the 18:30 demo rehearsal. We will not run an open happy hour past 2100 to stay under noise caps. Diego/Marissa — please confirm and I’ll sign off on the ShowOps budget line. Deadline to confirm: EOD 2026-11-19.

—Lauren Bishop
Director, Field & Event Operations
Redwood Inference
